notablePrerequisites: You have at least two creature cards in your graveyard.
easyPrerequisites: Deathbloom Ritualist and Kelpie Guide do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Kelpie Guide and Deathbloom Ritualist, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Kelpie Guide ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
